verdict.rationale: Highnote documents a dedicated Test environment, separate from Live, that replicates Live's full functionality. It lets developers simulate real-time transactions, authorizations, refunds, statements and compliance scenarios. That is a first-party sandbox for testing without going live. Missing for 10: an explicit statement that test data is isolated from production data, and any independent or hands-on corroboration of sandbox fidelity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: The Highnote Test environment (or dashboard) replicates the full functionality of the Live environment, and lets you simulate real-time transactions and compliance scenarios.
a test environment that behaves like production. Simulate authorizations, refunds, and statements before you talk to anyone.
